description: Exports Godot 4.7 projects: templates, export_presets.cfg for desktop, Web and Android, command-line exports and web COOP/COEP headers. Use on "No export template found", a blank web build, a SharedArrayBuffer error or files missing after export. Not for tests in CI (`godot-gdscript-headless-testing`), store uploads (`steam-publish`, `itch-publish`) or netcode (`godot-multiplayer`).
